job.title: Data Scientist – Energy Forecasting
job.description:
Nordlys Energi is hiring a Data Scientist to improve our short-term energy demand forecasts. You will work with time series, gradient boosting and deep learning models, and put models in production with our ML engineers.

Requirements:
- MSc in data science, statistics, physics or similar
- Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn)
- Experience with time series forecasting
- Docker and Git
- Working language is English

cv.name: Sofia Bianchi
cv.headline: Data scientist (MSc) with time series forecasting and Python experience
cv.summary: Master's student in Data Science at the University of Oslo (graduating June 2026) with a statistics background. Built a demand forecasting model on Oslo bike-share data with gradient boosting and has two years of part-time experience turning raw data into decisions.

bullets: Automated data cleaning of POS exports with Python and pandas
Built weekly sales dashboards in Power BI used by 12 store managers
Ran A/B tests on promotional emails and reported results to management
Run weekly exercise sessions for groups of 25 students
Grade assignments and hold office hours in English

details: Thesis: topic modelling of Norwegian news articles

projects.name: Oslo bike-share demand forecast
projects.description: Forecast hourly bike demand per station using public Oslo Bysykkel data and gradient boosting.

projects.name: Job ad language classifier
projects.description: Classifier detecting whether a job ad requires Norwegian, trained on 2,000 labelled ads.

cover_letter:
Dear Nordlys Energi team,

I am applying for the Data Scientist – Energy Forecasting position. I am completing an MSc in Data Science at the University of Oslo, and forecasting is the area I enjoy most.

In my Oslo bike-share project I forecast hourly demand per station with gradient boosting, working with seasonality, weather effects and noisy public data — problems close to short-term energy demand. Before my master's, I spent two years as a part-time data analyst, where I automated data cleaning with Python and pandas and presented results to non-technical managers.

I use Python, scikit-learn, Git and Docker daily. I have not yet deployed models in production, and I would be glad to learn this with your ML engineers.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be happy to tell you more in an interview.

Kind regards,
Sofia Bianchi

changes: Bike-share forecasting project moved to the top of projects
Data cleaning bullet moved first in the analyst role
